messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: unique genotypes
parts:
Hi Cat, 

If you are referring to identifying duplicated samples and/or clones, you can use the function gl.report.replicates in dartR.base. 

Note that we are not maintaining dartR anymore; instead, we are now developing the dartRverse. Have a look at the below link for further information, including how to install it:
https://green-striped-gecko.github.io/kioloa2/install.html 

Cheers,
Luis
